_notes: LLM Gateway, an OpenAI-compatible router: https://docs.llmgateway.io. Spec saved as docs/llmgateway-openapi.json.

needsServer: the hosted API sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (checked 2026-11-09 from https://hkarn.github.io and other origins), so browsers cannot call it from a static page such as GitHub Pages. It works through server.js (Docker or node server.js), which calls it server to server. On a static page it is greyed out in the picker and only its sign-up link is shown.

/v1/models needs no key. A model's tab comes from architecture.output_modalities (categorize); image+text models go to Image, text and audio+text to Chat, audio alone to Speech. The search and ocr models (3 on 2026-11-09: perplexity-search, perplexity-search-fast, mistral-ocr-latest) have no tab here, so they are only in the Filter models table.
Model ids are bare (gpt-4o: the gateway picks the provider and can fall back) or provider/model (pinned, no fallback).

Image edits are JSON to /images/edits with the pictures as data URLs in images[].image_url (1-16), and no mask (endpoints.imageEdit). Image options have size, aspect_ratio and quality but no resolution.

Video (POST /v1/videos, spec in docs/llmgateway-openapi.json) takes seconds (required), size as widthxheight, audio, and the pictures as image and last_frame (one data URL each), not OpenRouter's duration/resolution/aspect_ratio/frame_images: endpoints.video maps the page's fields onto those, and required.video makes the duration always sent. Polling and the video are /v1/videos/{id} and /content as with OpenAI. modelFields reads each video model's facts from its first providers[] entry (sizes, durations, audio); a model takes a starting picture when input_modalities has image or it lists image-to-video durations (Seedance lists text only, so the tools treat it as text-to-video). Its image-to-video durations, per-second prices and last-frame support are not read. Checked against the spec and the public model list (20 video models on 2026-11-09).
Checked 2026-11-09 through server.js with a key: the model list (291 models) and one chat call; the image edit format against the spec only.

attributionHeaders is false: its CORS allows only its own request headers (Content-Type, Authorization, x-api-key, x-session-id, …), so direct browser calls must not add HTTP-Referer and X-Title. llmgateway-self.json extends this file.
guide is the text of the Providers tab: how hard the setup is (level 1-4 and ease), a summary, the steps, and what is good or to watch. Shown with the signup link.

signup.text: No key? Sign up for LLM Gateway

needsServerReason: LLM Gateway does not allow calls from a browser page (no CORS), so it only works when you run your own server: Docker or node server.js.

guide.ease: Easy key, needs your own server
guide.summary: Getting a key is easy, but the hosted API does not accept calls from a web page, so it only works when you run this playground yourself.
steps: Sign up at LLM Gateway with the link below and add credit.
Run this playground yourself: docker compose up, or node server.js (see the README on GitHub).
Open your own copy, pick LLM Gateway and paste the key.
good: One key for many providers, and it can fall back to another provider when one fails.
watch: Greyed out on the GitHub Pages site: the hosted API sends no CORS header.
